businesses.business: blood and plasma collection and hospital blood management devices

offering_description.value: Develops and manufactures medical devices, disposables and software for plasma collection, blood donation, and hospital hemostasis and transfusion management. Sells to plasma fractionators, blood centers, hospitals and vascular care providers.

primary_products.value: plasma collection systems and disposables; whole blood collection and processing devices; hemostasis analyzers and cartridges; vascular closure devices; blood management software

customer_segment.value: B2B: plasma fractionators and collectors, blood centers, hospitals, cardiac surgery and interventional cardiology units; B2G: government-run hospitals and national blood services

end_markets.value: plasma collection; blood banking; hospital surgery and critical care; interventional cardiology

revenue_model.value: product sales: recurring disposables and consumables used with devices, plus devices and software; rental or leasing: devices placed at customer sites under reagent or disposable agreements; service fees: equipment service and software support contracts
revenue_model.category: product sales; rental or leasing; service fees

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: manufactures devices and disposables from purchased components, sold to plasma, blood center and hospital customers

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Japan, China and other Asia-Pacific markets

specialization.value: related lines: plasma, blood center, hospital hemostasis and vascular closure products sharing blood-related technology and customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales force selling to plasma companies, blood centers and hospitals; distributors / dealers: distributors in smaller or international markets

regulatory_exposure.value: high: medical devices needing FDA clearance or approval and CE/MDR and other international authorizations
